As a Software Engineer Intern this is your opportunity to:
• Gain exciting real-world software engineering experience at a thriving company.
• Work on a small team in a collaborative environment with seasoned software developers.
• Use your knowledge and experience with native and cross-platform mobile development to 
design, develop and test mobile applications for Resideo that enable our products and 
services.
• Use your experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals
• Work within a full stack team to deliver high quality mobile experiences to our customers.
• Identify and propose technical improvements using your software engineering knowledge 
and principles
 

YOU MUST HAVE:
• Currently studying or recent completion of a Computer Science/Network Engineering, Engineering, or Mathematics major
• Experience using software development tools and processes
• Excellent analytical and communication skills
• Ability to work in a collaborative team environment
 

WE VALUE:
• Excellent analytical and communication skills
• Ability to work in a collaborative team environment
• Experience developing native iOS and Android apps in Swift and Java/Kotlin and experience with the Dart/Flutter cross platform framework
• Knowledge and experience with REST APIs
• Experience with automated testing of mobile applications
• Experience working in an Agile environment
• Strong debugging skills
• Experience with continuous integration tools such as GitHub Workflows
• Experience with software source control using GIT
• GitHub experience
• Experience developing Bluetooth / BLE applications
• Creative Thinking
• New and innovative ideas
• Collaboration and teamwork
• Attention to detail
• High quality work product

#LI-Hybrid

", "CorporateDescriptionStr" : "

Resideo is a global leader in smart home and building solutions, with trusted brands including Honeywell Home, First Alert, and Resideo helping people feel more comfortable, secure, connected, and in control every day. Our products and technologies are found in more than 150 million homes and businesses worldwide. From intelligent climate solutions to security, sensing, water, and connected home technologies, Resideo develops and manufactures products designed to simplify everyday life and help protect what matters most. Our global teams span engineering, manufacturing, software, product management, supply chain, customer experience, and more — all working together to shape the future of connected living through innovation, quality, and meaningful real-world impact. At Resideo, our teams help create products and experiences that make everyday life more comfortable, secure, and connected for millions around the world. Learn more at www.resideo.com.

\n

\n

You can find out more about how the talent community works here: Resideo Talent Community Terms. Our recruitment privacy notice  Resideo -Recruitment Privacy Notice - Dec 16 2022 describes in more detail how we process your personal data and how you can exercise your personal data rights.

\n

If a disability prevents you from applying for a job through our website, request assistance here.
